description: This practice-driven course prepares computing students for workplace communication in AI-rich environments. Students learn active listening, strategic questioning, and calibrated responses; collaborate to elicit and synthesize diverse perspectives for problem framing and root-cause analysis; and integrate generative AI with human judgment to produce fast, clear, audience-tailored messages. Through case studies, feedback giving, reflections, students learn to craft workplace artefacts across diverse platforms while developing an authentic, credible presence. Metacognitive-inspired reflections strengthen students’ awareness of when to trust, verify, and refine AI outputs.
